data.name: Jibriyal
data.gender_notes: Jibriyal is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jibriyal is a beautiful Arabic name derived from the word Jibril, which means 'God's gentle and kind messenger'. In Islamic tradition, Jibril is the angel who conveys divine messages to prophets, including the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Jibriyal carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind, God's Messenger” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jibriyal usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind, god's messenger and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the blessings of divine guidance and the importance of being a messenger of love and peace.
data.etymology: Jibriyal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Kind, God's Messenger.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jibriyal total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
